loan.title: Loan Calculator
loan.subtitle: Understand different loan types, visualize your payments, and find the best option for your situation. We'll show you exactly where your money goes.

ANNUITY.name: Fixed Payment Loan
ANNUITY.shortDescription: Same payment every period, most common type
ANNUITY.calculatorDescription: Calculate your periodic payment and see how it breaks down over time.
ANNUITY.howItWorks1: You pay the same amount every period for the entire loan term
ANNUITY.howItWorks2: Early payments are mostly interest, later payments are mostly principal
ANNUITY.howItWorks3: The total debt decreases steadily over time
ANNUITY.bestFor3: People who prefer stability over flexibility
ANNUITY.watchOut1: You pay more interest in the early years
ANNUITY.watchOut2: Less flexibility if your income changes

CONSTANT_PRINCIPAL.name: Declining Payment Loan
CONSTANT_PRINCIPAL.shortDescription: Payments start high and decrease over time
CONSTANT_PRINCIPAL.calculatorDescription: See how your payments decrease over time as you pay off the principal.
CONSTANT_PRINCIPAL.howItWorks1: You pay a fixed amount of principal each period, plus interest
CONSTANT_PRINCIPAL.howItWorks2: As the debt decreases, so does the interest, making payments smaller
CONSTANT_PRINCIPAL.howItWorks3: Total interest paid is less than a fixed payment loan
CONSTANT_PRINCIPAL.bestFor1: People expecting lower income later (near retirement)
CONSTANT_PRINCIPAL.bestFor2: Those who can afford higher initial payments
CONSTANT_PRINCIPAL.bestFor3: Borrowers who want to minimize total interest paid
CONSTANT_PRINCIPAL.watchOut1: Initial payments can be 20-30% higher than fixed payment loans
CONSTANT_PRINCIPAL.watchOut2: May not qualify if income barely covers the first payment

INTEREST_ONLY.name: Interest-Only Loan
INTEREST_ONLY.shortDescription: Pay only interest, then principal later
INTEREST_ONLY.calculatorDescription: Pay only interest for a period, then start paying principal.
INTEREST_ONLY.howItWorks1: For a set period, you only pay interest - the debt doesn't decrease
INTEREST_ONLY.howItWorks2: After the interest-only period, you start paying principal too
INTEREST_ONLY.howItWorks3: Payments jump significantly when the principal payments begin
INTEREST_ONLY.bestFor1: Real estate investors expecting to sell before principal payments start
INTEREST_ONLY.bestFor2: People expecting higher income in the future
INTEREST_ONLY.watchOut1: You build no equity during the interest-only period
INTEREST_ONLY.watchOut2: Payment shock when regular payments begin
INTEREST_ONLY.watchOut3: Risk of owing more than the asset is worth

BULLET.name: Balloon / Bullet Loan
BULLET.shortDescription: Pay interest only, entire principal due at end
BULLET.calculatorDescription: Pay interest only throughout, with the full principal due at the end.
BULLET.howItWorks1: You pay only interest throughout the entire loan term
BULLET.howItWorks2: The full principal amount is due as one lump sum at the end
BULLET.howItWorks3: Periodic payments are very low, but you need a plan for the final payment
BULLET.bestFor1: Bridge financing (short-term loans until permanent financing is arranged)
BULLET.bestFor2: Investors planning to sell the asset before the loan matures
BULLET.watchOut1: High risk - you must have a plan to pay off or refinance
BULLET.watchOut2: If you can't pay the balloon, you could lose the asset
BULLET.watchOut3: No equity built during the loan term
